note: Every path that differs from adopted_base. A newer upstream SHA requires this inventory and the managed-mode coverage tests to be run again. License and notice files are unchanged and are not listed here.

paths.purpose: Fork bookkeeping: upstream relationship, managed versus standalone mode, visible AGPL obligations, and the statement that no Freedom release exists yet.
Machine-readable list of paths changed from the adopted base, with purpose and new-or-modified status.
Readable patch inventory for the same paths as patch-inventory.json.
Pins the upstream repository, research pin, adopted base, license expression, and preserved notice files.
Runs the managed-mode HTTP gate before handlers, adds loopback /freedom/v1/status, and stops wildcard CORS in managed mode.
Rejects settings writes that try to switch or relax managed mode, without applying the rest of that write.
Sends managed tool calls through the Freedom pipeline before the upstream guards. Cancellation uses the client token and the operator stop flag, not result text.
In managed mode, navigate calls the shared http(s) and about:blank allowlist. Standalone keeps the upstream scheme refusal and its English error text.
Denies nested helper execution in managed mode and skips helper preload and discovery.
Re-exports server-local MCP tool names so the coverage registry can see them.
Denies nested script primitives, helper reads, and page claims while the process is managed.
Prechecks every MCP tool call before session resolution. Managed request_human_help pins only the granted page, not the cockpit active tab.
Holds the process Freedom runtime, refuses to open a managed profile in standalone mode, and writes the managed marker only on the resolved distinct profile directory.
Adds the startup-only --freedom-managed and --freedom-profile flags and the default standalone directory helper.
Verifying constructor for FreedomRunContext. No Default, no public fields, and no deserializer.

Managed-mode pipeline. tabs active and new are unscoped, request_human_help needs an in-scope page, and navigation URLs are an http(s) or about:blank allowlist. The view-source prefix is matched on a character boundary.
Loopback peer, Host, Origin, per-process native token, and single-use nonce checks for /freedom/v1.
Process-wide Freedom runtime. Mode is fixed after startup and the journal never records business acceptance.

Resolves managed versus standalone from the CLI and sidecar. An existing marker file is managed. Profile paths are canonicalized as given, without a lexical .. pop; a .. left in a missing tail fails closed.
Coverage registry of HTTP routes, MCP tools, and native entry points with managed-mode treatment.
Declares the freedom module.
Selects managed mode only at process start, resolves the managed profile before creating logs, binds 127.0.0.1, and publishes the bound port for the Host allowlist.
Admits src/freedom as its own layer. HTTP and MCP may call it. The guard cannot depend on HTTP, MCP, services, or the database.
NEO-08 registry drift checks and the property test that every effect surface is denied without a context.
NEO-01, NEO-02, NEO-03, NEO-04, NEO-05, NEO-06, NEO-07, and NEO-12 integration cases, plus standalone unchanged.
Fails when the git diff against the adopted base and this inventory disagree. Uses local git only.
